name: Napkin AI
tagline: Turn your text into editable diagrams, charts, and infographics — no prompting.
description: Napkin AI generates business visuals directly from text you already wrote: paste a paragraph, click, and it produces diagrams, flowcharts, scenes, and infographics with no prompt required. The AI reads context and relationships and offers multiple visual options you can recolor, restyle, and edit, then export as PPT, PNG, PDF, or SVG. It supports 60+ languages and real-time team collaboration.
insight: Built by the founders of Osmo (sold to Byju's for $120M); launched from stealth in Aug 2024 with $10M from Accel and CRV.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary text-to-visual pipeline over LLM parsing.

edge: Generates editable, on-brand diagrams straight from your existing text — no prompting — where most tools make static images or need a blank canvas.
pros: No prompting — visuals come from your text
Exports to PPT, PNG, PDF, SVG
cons: Best for diagrams, not freeform illustration
Style range narrower than general image tools

references.title: Napkin turns text into visuals with generative AI
